Figure 2:Absolute label-efficiency curves on the anchor-matched follow-up.Points average five
outer-seed estimates after averaging the five fixed label-subset draws and task-balanced evaluation
episodes within each seed; bars are 95% outer-seed bootstrap intervals. Lower is better. The
same frozen checkpoints, probes, budgets, and episodes produce the registered paired AUC effects in
TableIII. Each panel uses its own vertical scale; comparisons are within panel.
